reference: Runnable expectations are Bash's documented type/help metadata contract and the swapoff builtin synopsis/documentation in /source/loadables/swapoff.c and /source/docs/sol-swapoff.md. There are no operation parity cases: invoking swapoff is expressly out of scope, and a denied syscall would not establish operational parity.
coverage: Bash identifies swapoff as a builtin with an empty candidate PATH.
Bash help exposes the builtin synopsis, short description, and documented behavior.
Deferred operation scopes identify the independent mock or disposable-VM requirements for named operands, -a table handling, and real kernel removal.
exclusions: No runnable case invokes the swapoff builtin or GNU util-linux swapoff; kernel swap changes are prohibited for this task.
The deferred operation cases are not passes and establish no swapoff syscall, /proc/swaps parsing, privilege, or kernel behavior.

cases.purpose: Verify Bash resolves the statically loaded swapoff command as a builtin while candidate PATH is empty.
Verify Bash's documented -s mode prints the builtin usage synopsis supplied by the swapoff metadata.
Verify Bash help reports the documented short description for swapoff.
Check the built-in help includes the documented named-path, -a, malformed-row, usage-combination, and privilege contract without calling swapoff.
cases.script:
doc=$(help swapoff)
[[ $doc == *"Named operands are literal paths; use -- before a name beginning with '-'."* ]] || exit 1
[[ $doc == *"-a/--all reads /proc/swaps, decodes pathnames and skips duplicates."* ]] || exit 1
[[ $doc == *"Malformed rows are reported and skipped; valid entries are still attempted."* ]] || exit 1
[[ $doc == *"-a cannot be combined with device operands."* ]] || exit 1
[[ $doc == *"Requires root."* ]] || exit 1
printf 'documented help fields present\n'

cases.purpose: Exercise literal named operands, -- for a leading dash, repeated explicit operands, and continuation/status behavior when a request fails.
cases.reason: Requires a disposable VM with owned swap areas or an independently reviewed libc swapoff mock that records operand order, injects selected errno results, and never forwards requests; add a seccomp denial for raw swapoff as a backstop. No operation is run in this suite.

cases.purpose: Exercise -a/--all against controlled /proc/swaps data, including header validation, escaped path decoding, duplicate suppression, malformed rows, and valid-row continuation.
cases.reason: Requires a disposable VM or private /proc/swaps reader mock plus a libc swapoff mock with an independently specified ordered pathname oracle; both must prevent real swapoff requests, with seccomp denying the syscall. Validate empty, valid, duplicate, malformed, and invalid-header tables. No operation is run in this suite.

cases.purpose: Establish end-to-end behavior when the kernel actually disables swap and removes that area from the active table.
cases.reason: Requires a disposable VM with sufficient privilege and a swapfile or device created solely for this test, plus before/after verification that only that owned area changed. It must never target host swap or any shared machine. No operation is run in this suite.
